content:
The incident log shows that the FRD‑E140 errors were seen from **18:10 UTC to 19:15 UTC on 26 April 2026**.  
During that window the fraud‑scorer nodes reported that their velocity‑counter writes to redis‑features‑01 failed with **“OOM command not allowed”** (i.e., Redis was out of memory and refusing writes).
